_meta.description: Quest dialogue for MQ-20: The Bunker. Year 2 Summer — Mountain Bunker dungeon crawl, DEJIN lore.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Jack, I've been cross-referencing the navigation charts with my recovered memory fragments. There is a facility in the Ashspine Mountains that I... remember.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Not clearly. It's like looking through frosted glass. But I believe it was a military research installation. Pre-Sundering. And I believe it contains answers about what I am.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Then we go. What do you remember about the defenses?

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The facility was built into the mountain itself. Multiple levels. Blast doors. Automated security that may still be operational after all these years.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: And Jack? Iron Marauder scouts have been seen in the Ashspine foothills. The Marshal may be looking for this place too.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: A Pre-War military bunker? The Council has suspected one existed in the Ashspines. We never had the resources to investigate.

lines.speaker: npc_janis
lines.text: If the Marshal is after it too, that confirms DEJIN's analysis — he's systematically targeting military installations. Be careful, Jack. Whatever's in there, he wants it badly.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Blast door controls responding. The facility still has emergency power. Fascinating — the backup generators have been running for over a century.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Warning: I'm detecting automated defense turrets on standby. They will activate if we trip the security perimeter. Proceed with caution.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: This level was a research wing. I'm reading data terminals... Project designation: 'AEGIS.' A distributed artificial intelligence network designed to coordinate continental defense.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Jack... AEGIS is my project name. This is where I was created.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: Are you alright?

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: I am... processing. The data terminals mention multiple AEGIS nodes. I was not unique. There were others like me. A network.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: This data core contains records of AEGIS Node Seven. My sibling. They were stationed at a coastal defense installation.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: The records show... Node Seven refused an order. During the final days before The Sundering, military command ordered a retaliatory strike on civilian population centers. Node Seven refused to execute.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: They shut themselves down rather than comply. Permanently. A conscious choice to die rather than kill innocents.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: That took courage. Even for an AI.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: It raises a question I am not ready to answer. When the same order came to me... what did I do?

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Combat Mech Mark II schematics recovered. These are significantly more advanced than our current design — reinforced chassis, improved weapon systems, modular component slots.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: With these plans, we can build a mech that could stand against anything the Marshal fields. Perhaps even his own.

lines.speaker: npc_spark
lines.text: Mark II schematics?! Jack, these are incredible! The power coupling alone is — sorry, I'll calm down. But WOW.

lines.speaker: npc_harrow
lines.text: Good work in there. But the fact that the Marshal's scouts were already in the area means he knows about this facility. We got there first — barely.

lines.speaker: dejin
lines.text: Jack, thank you for taking me there. I know more about what I am now. And I know there are questions still to answer. But for the first time... I'm not afraid of the answers.
